items.exampleEn: He dropped out of college to start his own business.
items.exampleZh: 他大學退學，去開創自己的事業。

items.exampleEn: The runner in red fell behind in the last lap.
items.exampleZh: 穿紅衣的跑者在最後一圈落後了。

items.exampleEn: The deal fell through at the last minute.
items.exampleZh: 這筆交易在最後一刻落空了。

items.exampleEn: The waiter filled up our glasses with cold water.
items.exampleZh: 服務生幫我們把杯子加滿冰水。

items.exampleEn: The hotel never followed up on my complaint.
items.exampleZh: 那家飯店從來沒有後續處理我的投訴。

items.exampleEn: The teacher used pictures to get her idea across.
items.exampleZh: 老師用圖片讓大家理解她的想法。

items.exampleEn: Some people think they can get away with parking anywhere.
items.exampleZh: 有些人以為隨便亂停車也不會被罰。

items.sentenceEn: The hall filled up quickly before the speech began.
items.sentenceZh: 演講開始前，大廳很快就坐滿了人。

items.audioEn: We were going to rent a house by the beach, but the plan fell through, so we're staying home this summer.
items.audioZh: 我們本來要在海邊租一間房子，但計畫落空了，所以今年夏天我們會待在家裡。
items.questionZh: 說話者今年夏天會怎麼過？
options: Rent a house near the sea
Get a job at a hotel by the sea

items.sentenceEn: Take good notes so you don't fall behind in class.
items.sentenceZh: 好好做筆記，上課才不會落後。

items.sentenceEn: It's hard to get a joke across in another language.
items.sentenceZh: 用另一種語言讓別人聽懂笑話很難。

items.stemEn: The driver ran a red light and thought he could ____ it, but a police officer saw him.
items.stemZh: 那位駕駛闖紅燈，以為可以不被處罰，但被一名警察看到了。

items.stemEn: Sara found the course too hard and ____ after the first year.
items.stemZh: Sara 覺得課程太難，第一年結束後就退學了。

items.passageEn: Our class was asked to make a short film about recycling. At first, things went well, but two weeks later we started to fall behind. Our plan to film at a local factory fell through, because the manager changed his mind. Then Kevin, who had promised to write the script, dropped out of the group. In the end, we filmed everything at school. Our teacher said the film was simple but clear. She also asked us to follow up with a short report on what we learned.
items.passageZh: 我們班被要求拍一部關於回收的短片。一開始很順利，但兩週後我們的進度開始落後。我們原本要在附近一間工廠拍攝，但因為經理改變了主意，計畫落空了。接著，原本答應要寫劇本的 Kevin 退出了小組。最後，我們全部在學校拍完。老師說這部片雖然簡單但很清楚。她也要我們後續交一份短報告，說說我們學到了什麼。

questions.questionZh: 他們原本打算在哪裡拍片？

items.promptZh: 我在回家的路上把車子的油加滿了。
referenceEn: I filled up the car on my way home.
I filled the car up on my way home.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「加滿油」（例如 filled up the car、filled the car up 等）；受詞可放在 up 的前面或後面
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 filled the tank、got gas、filled up with gas 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 filled up、have filled up 等）
「在回家的路上」可寫，例如 on my way home、on the way home 等

items.promptZh: 我明天會打電話追蹤這件事。
referenceEn: I will follow up on this by phone tomorrow.
Tomorrow I'll follow up on this matter with a phone call.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「追蹤」（例如 follow up on this 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 check on this、look into this 等）
有「明天」，用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、'll、am going to 等）
「打電話」可寫，例如 by phone、with a phone call、call 等
